scope: Sweep 7 — Final 17 integration features (lifecycle + Google extras + bespoke OAuth + static + project + coming-soon)
summary: 17 features × ~5 TCs = 79 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. Disconnect (FEAT-084): idempotent — missing row returns {already_disconnected} (line 195). Status (FEAT-085): missing row returns disconnected stub; otherwise provider.status() (lines 200-238). Google extras (89,90,91): all reuse oauth_account from login; 403 surfaces as reauth_required for legacy users without scope. OpenWeatherMap (94): query-param auth (?appid=KEY). Stack Overflow (95): dual public+optional-token. Discord/Reddit/Linear: bespoke OAuth subclasses with provider quirks (Reddit User-Agent, Linear GraphQL). Static (106,107): no creds, connect=upsert; HN/Open-Meteo sync hits public APIs. Project providers (108-111): all use bulk factory's _ApiKeyProvider class with provider-specific probe URLs. Coming-soon (113): _make_coming_soon factory creates stubs that raise IntegrationError on connect/sync but return status='coming_soon' for the catalogue.

feature_defects.summary: PASS — Reddit User-Agent + Basic Auth verified

notes: FEAT-084 disconnect path doesn't currently revoke upstream tokens with the provider (e.g., POST to Google's revoke endpoint). Stored tokens are removed from local DB but the provider's grant remains until manual revocation. Acceptable for personal-use MVP; documented behaviour.
Coming-soon stubs report kind='personal_oauth' cosmetically; never used since connect raises immediately. No defect — code comment confirms.
Project providers' _ApiKeyProvider class inherits the DEF-112-01 config-replacement issue from the factory. Will be fixed once when the factory is fixed.
